replacement_language: CONSENSUS_APPROVAL_AUTHORITY is created only when Software Admin and Hardware Admin both explicitly concur on a bounded, current-scope, non-high-risk artifact or process. The record MUST bind exact scope, risk, impact, rationale, authority basis, both-role concurrence, and expiry or revocation when applicable. It permits only the acceptance, publication, registration, scheduling, or progression expressly allowed for that approved artifact or process class; it does not by itself permit host, database, connector, scheduler, permission, deployment, destructive, or other operational mutation. EXECUTION_AUTHORITY is a separate exact authorization bound to executor, target, operation, resources, destination, credential boundary, correlation, idempotency, expiry, rollback, and evidence requirements. High-risk, destructive, scope-expanding, authority-uncertain, or disputed work pauses for Corey. Neither role may lower, relabel, omit, or selectively reinterpret the risk of its own proposal to qualify it for consensus approval.
